School van driver arrested for alleged sexual assault of 4-year-old

A 4-year-old nursery student was allegedly sexually assaulted by a school van driver in Uttar Pradesh. The driver has been arrested by the police. The incident occurred in Lucknow, prompting an immediate police response and arrest.
